messages.subject: RE: Cygnet House - replies to CPSE.1 and CPSE.4
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Thank you. Two points we'll pick up in the contract mark-up: (1) we want the conduct and benefit of the Unit 4 review to pass to the buyer on completion, with your client restrained from settling it before completion without our client's consent; and (2) we'll be asking for the service charge retention to be £25,000 rather than £18,000, released within 10 working days of the reconciliation being agreed. Mark-up to follow shortly.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate — Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
DDI +44 (0)20 7946 0531
